# Study guide in 12 weeks

This page organizes existing modules into a weekly rhythm. The proposal is to study one topic per week, run the corresponding script and record a short interpretation of the results.
:::

::: {.page-hero-aside}
**Suggested pace**

1 module per week, with reading, script execution and short technical synthesis.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Use this track as a study plan. The links point to modules already published, avoiding empty pages or broken links.
:::

::: {.route-overview role="region" aria-label="Editorial rhythm of the 12-week trail"}
::: {.route-overview-copy}
## Suggested rhythm per phase

Use the roadmap as a consolidation sequence: each block of weeks caps off a shift in scale, from biological intuition to models and then to genomics.
:::

::: {.route-overview-grid}
::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 1-2**

Fundamentals of improvement and genetic decomposition of the phenotype.
:::

::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 3-6**

Exploration of data, variances, heritability, repeatability and correlations.
:::

::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 7-9**

Linear models, BLUP, pedigree and kinship as the basis for evaluation.
:::

::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 10-12**

SNP markers, quality control, genomic arrays, GWAS and prediction.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-week-decision role="region" aria-label="How to choose a weekly study rhythm"}
::: {.route-week-decision-copy}
**Adjust the rhythm without breaking the sequence**

One week per module is a guide. The important point is to preserve the complete cycle: reading, script, parameter change, interpretation and quiz.
:::

::: {.route-week-decision-grid role="list" aria-label="Possible rhythms for using the roadmap"}
::: {.route-week-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Light rhythm**

Separate reading and script into two days.
:::

::: {.route-week-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Standard rhythm**

Complete one full module per week.
:::

::: {.route-week-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Review pace**

Use the week to redo the script, quiz and synthesis.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-recovery-plan role="region" aria-label="How to recover the trail rhythm"}
::: {.route-recovery-plan-copy}
**If the week is late, recover by evidence**

Do not restart the entire track. Go back to the smallest verifiable point: question, script, or quiz. Then resume the sequence through the current phase.
:::

::: {.route-recovery-plan-grid role="list" aria-label="Actions to recover a delayed week"}
::: {.route-recovery-plan-item role="listitem"}
**I missed reading**

Review the module's objective, minimum evidence, and takeaways.
:::

::: {.route-recovery-plan-item role="listitem"}
**I lost the code**

Just run the main script and change one parameter.
:::

::: {.route-recovery-plan-item role="listitem"}
**I missed the closure**

Retake the quiz and write a short decision before moving on.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-session-plan role="region" aria-label="Session models for using the roadmap"}
::: {.route-session-plan-copy}
**Turn the week into a clear session**

The script can be used at different paces, as long as each session ends with a verifiable output.
:::

::: {.route-session-plan-grid role="list" aria-label="Practical session models"}
::: {.route-session-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Reading**

Use when you need to understand the question before running code.
:::

::: {.route-session-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

Use when you already know which parameter you want to test in the script.
:::

::: {.route-session-plan-item role="listitem"}
**Synthesis**

Use when you need to turn results into a short decision.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-output-check role="navigation" aria-label="How to review the week's technical evidence"}
::: {.route-output-check-copy}
**Review the week by type of departure**

Before marking a week as complete, check whether the evidence came from code, table or figure. If a format is weak, return to the right module before moving on to the next week.
:::

::: {.route-output-check-grid role="list" aria-label="Routes to review weekly technical evidence"}
::: {.route-output-check-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

Use when the doubt is in the script or changed parameter.

[Open M01](../modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 01 to review code evidence in the roadmap"}
:::

::: {.route-output-check-item role="listitem"}
**Table**

Use when the doubt is in comparison, parameter or correlation.

[Open M06](../modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 06 to review table evidence in the roadmap"}
:::

::: {.route-output-check-item role="listitem"}
**Figure**

Use when the doubt is in a visual pattern, marker or prediction.

[Open M12](../modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open Module 12 to review visual and genomic evidence in the roadmap"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-session-split role="region" aria-label="How to divide a week when time is short"}
::: {.route-session-split-copy}
**If the week is full, divide it without breaking the cycle**

It is not mandatory to solve reading, code and quiz on the same day. The important thing is to maintain order and close with a decision.
:::

::: {.route-session-split-grid role="list" aria-label="Short split of the study week"}
::: {.route-session-split-item role="listitem"}
**20 min**

Read objective, central concept, and expected evidence.
:::

::: {.route-session-split-item role="listitem"}
**30 min**

Run the script and record a comparison.
:::

::: {.route-session-split-item role="listitem"}
**10 min**

Take a quiz or write down your exit decision.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-evidence-ladder role="region" aria-label="Minimum evidence per roadmap cycle"}
::: {.route-evidence-ladder-copy}
**Turn the script into accumulated evidence**

Weekly advance should produce small, comparable tracks. At the end of each phase, the evidence changes from reading to interpretation and then to decision.
:::

::: {.route-evidence-ladder-grid role="list" aria-label="Evidence expected along the roadmap"}
::: {.route-evidence-ladder-item role="listitem"}
**Weeks 1-2**

Explain the biological question and the role of variation.
:::

::: {.route-evidence-ladder-item role="listitem"}
**Weeks 3-9**

Compare parameters, models and outputs before moving forward.
:::

::: {.route-evidence-ladder-item role="listitem"}
**Weeks 10-12**

Defend a technical decision involving genomic data.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-phase-handoff role="region" aria-label="How to move from one phase to another in the roadmap"}
::: {.route-phase-handoff-copy}
**Go through phases with a synthesis**

When moving from fundamentals to data, from data to modeling, or from modeling to genomics, take a short break. The next phase only becomes clear when the previous one left a defendable technical sentence.
:::

::: {.route-phase-handoff-grid role="list" aria-label="Steps to move through roadmap phases"}
::: {.route-phase-handoff-item role="listitem"}
**To close**

Write what the previous phase allowed you to decide.
:::

::: {.route-phase-handoff-item role="listitem"}
**Review**

Return to the key module if the sentence is still vague.
:::

::: {.route-phase-handoff-item role="listitem"}
**Next**

Open the next phase with a more specific question.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.route-weekly-output role="region" aria-label="Minimum output for each study week"}
::: {.route-weekly-output-copy}
**Every week you need to leave an exit**

The script works best when each week ends with something verifiable. The output does not need to be long, but it should connect reading, code and interpretation.
:::

::: {.route-weekly-output-grid role="list" aria-label="Weekly minimum outputs"}
::: {.route-weekly-output-item role="listitem"}
**Notice**

A question or concept that has become clear.
:::

::: {.route-weekly-output-item role="listitem"}
**Comparison**

A change in the script and the observed result.
:::

::: {.route-weekly-output-item role="listitem"}
**Decision**

A sentence about technical consequence.
:::
:::
:::

## Visual progress map

::: {.route-map-intro role="note" aria-label="How to read the visual progress map"}
Use the map as an advancement marker, not a scoreboard. The objective is to complete a cycle of reading, execution and interpretation per week.
:::

```{=html}
<div data-learning-map></div>
```

::: {.route-table-guide role="region" aria-label="How to use the week table"}
::: {.route-table-guide-copy}
**Read the table as a sequence of decisions**

Each line combines week, theme and practice. Use the practical column to define the smallest verifiable action before opening the module.
:::

::: {.route-table-guide-grid role="list" aria-label="How to interpret the roadmap columns"}
::: {.route-table-guide-item role="listitem"}
**Week**

Maintains order and rhythm.
:::

::: {.route-table-guide-item role="listitem"}
**Theme**

Point out the current module.
:::

::: {.route-table-guide-item role="listitem"}
**Practice**

Defines minimum evidence.
:::
:::
:::

| Week | Theme | Practice |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | [Introduction to Animal Improvement](../modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd) | Run `scripts/modulo01.R` and compare selection groups. |
| 2 | [Bases of Quantitative Genetics](../modules/modulo02-bases-da-genetica-quantitativa.qmd) | Relate phenotype, genetic value and environment. |
| 3 | [Descriptive statistics and exploration in R](../modules/modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd) | Describe distribution, mean and dispersion of simulated data. |
| 4 | [Means, variances, and variance components](../modules/modulo04-medias-variancias-e-componentes-de-variancia.qmd) | Compare sources of variation and biological interpretation. |
| 5 | [Heritability and repeatability](../modules/modulo05-herdabilidade-e-repetibilidade.qmd) | Test how changes in variance alter estimates. |
| 6 | [Genetic and phenotypic correlations](../modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd) | Discuss responses correlated to selection. |
| 7 | [Linear models and mixed models](../modules/modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd) | Separate fixed, random effects and residual error. |
| 8 | [BLUP and genetic evaluation](../modules/modulo08-blup-e-avaliacao-genetica.qmd) | Interpret ranking of selection candidates. |
| 9 | [Pedigree and kinship structure](../modules/modulo09-estrutura-de-pedigree-e-parentesco.qmd) | Assessing how kinship changes the comparison between individuals. |
| 10 | [Genomics and SNP markers](../modules/modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd) | Review the entry of SNP markers into the analytical flow. |
| 11 | [Genomic quality control](../modules/modulo11-controle-de-qualidade-de-dados-genomicos.qmd) | Plan filters for simulated genomic data. |
| 12 | [Genomic arrays, GWAS and prediction](../modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd) | Connect genomic matrix, association and prediction. |

## Recommended routine

::: {.routine-grid}
::: {.routine-card}
**01**

Read the module before opening the script.
:::

::: {.routine-card}
**02**

Run the corresponding script.
:::

::: {.routine-card}
**03**

Change a simulation parameter.
:::

::: {.routine-card}
**04**

Compare the new output with the original.
:::

::: {.routine-card}
**05**

Write a short technical conclusion.
:::
:::

::: {.route-finish-band role="region" aria-label="Study trail closure"}
::: {.route-finish-copy}
**Close each week with evidence**

The script only becomes real progress when the reading, scripting and short interpretation are completed. Use the module quizzes as a spot check before progressing to the certificate.
:::

::: {.public-session-check .route-session-check role="region" aria-label="Quick check before closing a week"}
::: {.public-session-check-copy}
**Before closing the week**

A completed week leaves enough technical trail to resume without rereading everything.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-grid role="list" aria-label="Weekly closing check"}
::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Reading**

The main concept was located in the module.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

The script has been executed or revised.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Decision**

A short conclusion was written.
:::
:::
:::
